resources.string: A little order.\nA lot of space.
Your files, your device. No account needed.
No visible files in this folder.
This folder is unavailable or Android has restricted access. Try another folder or check file access.
More matching items are available. This alpha still enumerates the whole folder; the display limit is 100,000.
This file cannot be opened. Check access and whether a compatible app is installed.
Android file-access settings are not available on this device.
Android requires your permission to browse shared storage. This alpha only lists files and opens selected files read-only in another app. Restricted folders remain protected.
No ads, analytics or mandatory account. This build has no Internet permission. The external app you choose to open a file has its own privacy policy.
Alpha 0.5 · Local and SAF browsing, folder search, sorting, hidden files, selection and local folder creation. Local file copy without overwrite; no move or deletion.
Later milestones: folder/SAF copy, move/rename/delete with safeguards, global search, archives, readers, cloud/NAS, sharing and optional Shizuku.
Choose a folder with Android. Only read access is retained. No all-files permission is needed for these folders. The selected provider may use its own network connection.
Forget Cantas access to this folder? No file will be deleted. Choose it again in Android to reconnect.
Read access could not be retained. Choose the folder again and confirm access.
Android’s folder picker is not available on this device.
This connected folder is unavailable. Check the card or USB connection and Android access, or choose the folder again.
Folder connections could not be read or changed. Try again; access may still be retained.
Create one local folder here. Existing files and folders will never be replaced. SD/USB connections remain read-only.
Use 1–255 UTF-8 bytes, no surrounding spaces, slash, backslash, control characters, dot or dot-dot.
This name is already used. Choose another name; nothing was replaced.
Folder creation is not allowed here. Check Android write access.
The destination is no longer available. Close this dialog and refresh.
This storage is read-only in this milestone.
The folder could not be created. Check access, free space and the name; refresh before retrying.
Folder created: %1$s. Current filters or the display limit may hide it.
%1$d items staged. Navigate to a local destination folder.

Local or authorized SAF sources to LOCAL storage only. Folder contents include hidden items regardless of filters. Up to 100 roots, 1,000 entries, depth 32. Unknown SAF file lengths are capped at 512 MiB per file; exceeding this leaves an unverified partial output. Choose a separate destination: opaque SAF IDs cannot prove physical disjointness. Existing names are skipped, folders NEVER merged. Originals are opened read-only. Partial outputs remain; no automatic cleanup. A cloud provider may download data under its own policies.
Cancellation stops after the current blocking read/write returns. Originals are kept; partial outputs are not deleted.

This operation was interrupted or its journal/access could not be verified. Requested names below may already have existed. Inspect the destination manually; files may be incomplete. Nothing is retried or deleted automatically.
Some newly created outputs are incomplete or unverified. They remain under the listed original names. Do not treat them as completed copies.
Source changed or size differs — unverified
Failed — inspect any newly created output
Closing clears this private report only. It does not remove any source or destination file.
Local write access was not granted. No file operation was started.
Copy local or authorized SAF sources to a LOCAL folder only. Up to 100 roots, 1,000 entries, depth 32.
Folder created — see child results, not a completion guarantee
Preparation stopped or refused before destination creation: check access, names, links/types, limits and destination (never inside the source). No destination entry was created.
